messages:
luca: Hey folks — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/48291 touches eviction allocator + routing. Need runtime, infra, and security eyes before I can schedule a canary. Can @anya (runtime), @marco (infra) and @sam (sec) please take a look? TL;DR: changes `evict_priority()` and adds a new header `x-eviction-reason`. Breaking for some custom allocators, but default path unchanged.

anya: looking now. If it's just header + priority ordering, shouldn't be too bad. What's the canary window you're thinking?

luca: canary tomorrow morning 9am PT (low traffic). Also need to know if infra needs config rollout for kube affinity. @marco?

marco: I'll check affinity implications. If we add header nothing infra-wise, but the allocator flag `enable_priority_shuffle` is new — will need a config flip. Ping me with the exact flag name in the PR.

luca: flag is `allocator.enable_priority_shuffle`. I added a short migration note in the PR. Also CI failed on integration: `TestAllocatorCooldown` flaky, not sure if related.

merge-bot: CI status — 2/5 checks passed, failing: integration-tests (flake) and lint. Logs: `TestAllocatorCooldown timed out`.

sam: re: sec, quick scan — header `x-eviction-reason` looks fine but we should avoid leaking tenant IDs. Make sure it's sanitized. I'll open a tiny nit PR if needed.

anya: runtime nit — need to preserve KV cache ordering when priority shuffle enabled. I left a comment in the PR with a suggested guard: `if (!allocator->preserve_kv_order) ...`.

luca: thanks. @marco — if infra can flip `allocator.enable_priority_shuffle` at canary, we'll roll it as a feature flag and monitor. @sam can we get a +1 on no sensitive payloads?

sam: I can +1 conditional on removal of tenant id from the header. Will follow-up in PR comment.

marco: infra +1 on ability to roll flag per cluster. I'll add canary schedule to the runbook. Need a runtime +1 before I sign off.

anya: runtime +1 after I confirm the KV guard works. Will run a quick local test and update.

luca: great. tagging owners: @anya (runtime), @marco (infra), @sam (security), @devops: can we get a schedule slot 9am PT tomorrow? :calendar: 

devops: slot noted, but need two LGTM to proceed.

luca: understood. pinging again in the morning if no objections. Thanks all :pray:
